The '''Annaj House of Detention''' was a [[Prison/Legends|detention center]] built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]]. The treasure hunter [[Barzur Antilles]] was at one point in his career incarcerated there, and while imprisoned questioned about the treasure known as the [[Tessent]].
